# M0-b-03 — closing check of hardening round S7 (lane `check/M0-b-03-close-s7`, flow flow-7, stage group S, 2026-10-26)

Lane `check/M0-b-03-close-s7` ran under Opus 5.5 in Claude Code in a Claude Code cloud container (Linux x64, Intel Xeon
4 cpu, 16 GiB, Node v24.12.0) on 2026-10-26 from 03:01 to about 10:15 UTC. The machine check printed
`linux:Intel(R) Xeon(R) Processor @ 2.80GHz:4cpu:16gib`, which matches the brief. The seat is the implementer-side
closing checker of the session's hardening round S7 (J162, J237 (2), J489). It wrote no part of the item and is none
of its authors; the round's author is `build/M0-b-03-fix-s7` (L-0651). Its own ledger row is L-0652.

How the seat worked:

  `checks/M0-b-03-notes.md` (rows S7-1 to S7-6), its CLEAN-ROOM row, its two landed records and its lane-log

## Verdict: FAIL — three failing lines (L20, Q65, Q70), each a pin the round promised and a mutant that moves honest output past it

Every other line of the brief is confirmed fixed, pinned, stated or validly reported. The census never rises (it falls
on every family). The gates pass as far as the protocol reads them (RELATED's two reds are red identically on the
before-image). The code is right on every line the seat measured; **what fails is three pins**:

1. **L20** — the needle rule's "minimum usable width at the tip" (the sides read **along the ring over the plot's
   minimum width**, C-0423 (1)) has no pin. Mutant **Y04** (the sides read at the corner's adjacent ring vertices)
   leaves NEAR green (24 files, 179 / 179) and every RELATED file that reaches its change at 1000 (5 files, 44 / 44: bench `determinism/spike`, layout `districts/integration`, `enceinte/bend`, `pipeline/base/run`, `siting/decks`) and moves honest output: base river 900 seeds 2 and 4 change root,
   each losing its one `needle` refusal. On river 2 it commits `block:e6gaq47nyt46z`, whose kerb carries a **blunt
   needle** on lane `way:9x968kc8amk63`'s band: two tip vertices (30446, 12378) and (30404, 12368), 42 cm apart, the
   sides 11.8° apart over 2.5 m — the smoke's own shape (a needle 10–26 cm wide whose end is cut off where the edges come
   within attractCm). The tree's rule refuses that cut; under Y04 it stands.
2. **Q65** — "a DECLARED shift (the blocks these faces now get) with the digests re-recorded in the round": the blocks
   the 59 formerly unresolved faces now get are recorded nowhere. Mutant **Y19** (the squared end's leg L / 2 instead of
   min(e_lo / 2, L / 3), C-0423 (2)) leaves NEAR green and the RELATED files that reach it at 1000 (`pipeline/base/run`, `pipeline/core/rows-base`: 18 / 18) and moves the committed lanes and blocks of **every**
   replayed face measured (16 of 16; each still cut, ≤ 1 kernel call), so any change to the squared construction is
   silent.
3. **Q70** — NO-SHIFT is measured (0 divergences in 13 010 mint calls) but not pinned where the incremental set can go
   wrong: mutant **Y23** (`LiveIndex.pop` drops the entry from the list and leaves both indexes holding it) leaves NEAR
   green and the 21 RELATED files that reach it at 1000 (147 / 147) and silently moves minted identities on an honest run: base flat 900 seed 2 (one `needle` refusal, its
   lane taken out, then a mint at the same creation index) changes its `lanes` key and its model root
   (`1739f827…` → `4c472856…`) with the census unchanged — the stale index hands the mint a lineage that is no longer
   live, so the lane takes dup 1 where the whole-list mint gives dup 0. `mint.test.ts`'s three planted scenarios
   (beside its own entities, a third time, beside squatters) never take a lane out.

Per the brief, a survivor on a stated promise that is not equivalent stays a blocker; each of the three changes an
honest output. Each needs a pin only (the shapes are in the failing lines below).
